WHEN: between the close of FIMRCC01 and the launch of LDFMA01, in the same session
WHAT_HAPPENED: the container reverted to the FDOT01 C2 snapshot (82f6c84) for the fifth time. TLMR01, FIMRCC01, MCTT01/out, BPRTC01/out and every staged upload were erased from the container. The rolled-back snapshot also restored the partial-clone promisor, so git cat-file began consulting GitHub again and reported the missing commits as 'upload-pack: not our ref' rather than as locally absent.
WHY_IT_COST_572_KB_AND_NOT_124_MB: the durability package was built as two INCREMENTS whose prerequisites chain to a commit the snapshot already contains, rather than as one self-contained bundle. The 124 MB self-contained bundle exists on Windows as the fallback for a container that has nothing at all; it was not needed here.

THREE_UNTRACKED_FDOT01_FILES.what: the snapshot restored FDOT01_DURABILITY.json, FDOT01_FREEZE_BINDING.json and FDOT01_RUN_LEDGER.jsonl as untracked files, blocking the checkout
THREE_UNTRACKED_FDOT01_FILES.what_was_checked_before_removing_them: each was compared byte for byte against the version committed in 19fa6be; all three were identical, so removing them lost nothing

LESSON_ALREADY_APPLIED: externalise as increments chained to a commit the snapshot contains. That is what made this recovery a two-file operation.
